# Getting Support

Ways to get help with this project:

- **Questions and discussion** — start with the [README](../README.md) and
  [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md); if you're still stuck, open an issue with
  the "Blank issue" template and describe what you're trying to do.
- **Bug reports and feature requests** — [search existing issues](https://github.com/fini-net/gh-observer/issues?q=)
  first, then use the [issue templates](https://github.com/fini-net/gh-observer/issues/new/choose).
  Include enough detail for someone else to reproduce the problem.
- **Security vulnerabilities** — do NOT open a public issue; follow the
  [confidential disclosure process](SECURITY.md).
- **Commercial or urgent support** — this project is maintained by
  volunteers in their spare time; there is no SLA and no paid support
  option.  Pull requests that fix problems are the fastest way to get
  attention.

## What to expect

- This is a spare-time project, so response times vary.  A well-written
  issue with reproduction steps gets answered much faster than "it doesn't
  work".
- Feature requests are welcome, but the best ones come with a pull request
  attached.  See [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the development
  process.
